headline: Nevish Line Swings Back to Wardens; Linn Mercy Passes to Colonials
war_summary:
Ground has shifted on two fronts since the last edition. In the Nevish Line the Wardens have recovered two works, the sector now reading five Colonial and three Warden with no unclaimed ground; it remains the war's busiest quarter, with fifty-nine actions in the day and ten in the past two hours as casualties mount on both sides. Linn Mercy has gone the other way: the two Warden works reported there earlier are gone, leaving ten Colonial and one unclaimed, though fighting has eased to four actions in two hours.

Callahan's Passage, ten Warden works a short while ago, now shows nine Warden and one unclaimed, with sixteen actions in the day, chiefly at Crumbling Post. The Weathered Expanse stands unchanged at seven Warden and two unclaimed after forty-three actions in the day, none in the past two hours. Mooring County remains eleven Warden to one Colonial, and Marban Hollow four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed; both are quiet of late though the casualty rolls continue to run.

Warden losses at the Clahstra ran near two thousand an hour without ground changing hands. Colonial holdings remain the greater across the map.
